title: Advanced Optics Design&Validation Student - Camera HW
description:
The Apple Camera Hardware Engineering group is responsible for all research, design, development, test and qualification of camera hardware for Apple products. The team in Israel is looking for a Design&Validation Student 
who will join a team responsible for end-to-end design, production and testing of high quality micro-optic components. The team features a collaborative and hands-on environment that fosters engineering excellence, creativity, and innovation in the interdisciplinary areas of optical design, testing and device fabrication.
